display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig 通用实增益 DURA 源域筛查
description: 同一恢复器接收 LoRa 8192 点或 WiSig 256 点原生复数 IQ。两个数据集独立从零训练。候选在每个 DURA 阶段以逐频点实数增益控制观测创新，控制组在同位置将增益取包平均。
authorization: Current user LoRa and WiSig fusion objective and small screening before any complete target release.

permissions.claim_scope: Training uses U_s IQ and independently generated matched pairs only. No frozen F logits/weights, legacy G, true TX labels, V or target data in fitting or clean calibration. Control and candidate predictions frozen before independent CPU V truth scoring.

checkpoint.initialization: Random joint training from scratch with the same seed, paired batches, architecture and trainable count across datasets. The benchmark loaders are used exclusively for separate frozen control predictions after the new checkpoints freeze.

Original 266,951-parameter WiSig R69 and default deployment graph
Standalone LoRa native gain baseline; E104 reader frozen

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Strict frozen checkpoint load and actual no-query U_s smoke on both datasets.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Dataset-native weights from independent lawful U_s. Same inference graph, shared action/gain/prior/solver code, with original classifier-specific adapters outside recovery.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed terminal 6400 steps. After fitting each arm, freeze its .995 clean quality cut from 512 disjoint lawful U_s records, using the same formula. For primary frequency arm, each of the 3 original controls requires >=8/160 net and paired CI lower >0 on low urban, and Clean must match the best. Full phase only if passed and separately preregistered.

execution.launch_owner: Current LoRa performance chat, dual dataset objective
execution.gpu_policy: N607 physical {3,5,7}, at least 12288 MiB free and fewer than eight existing compute contexts. At most one new worker on each used card. Preserve other owners and concurrent s2026113113 on GPU0/2.
execution.stop_rule: One immutable output root. Real lawful U_s gradient smoke before training and real frozen checkpoint U_s prediction smoke before any V prediction. Fail on contract, nonfinite output/loss or absent checked worker output. Both registered panels freeze before truth connection. No automatic target.

notes: Source training consumes no prior restoration checkpoints. DURA observation model is 32 complex FIR taps, an 8-knot interpolated phase and a bounded complex image term. Each stage applies bounded real gain to the adjoint residual, learns a time-domain prior correction and runs 2 weighted MAP CG iterations.

Matched arm preserves all weights, capacity, losses, inputs and solver settings. Only the frequency gain is replaced with its packet mean. Each dataset uses the same algorithm and method configuration, with its own fitted weights and source clean quality cutoff.
Exposure: historic screen comparisons informed the research question only. No RX rule inside recovery. Full target never accessed by this run.
